SumatraPDF 3.6.1 x64 portable
Copyright the SumatraPDF authors and contributing third-party projects.
Project: https://github.com/sumatrapdfreader/sumatrapdf
Release source: tag 3.6.1rel

Print Bridge does not bundle or redistribute SumatraPDF binaries. On the user's
explicit request in Settings, the app downloads the unmodified portable release
directly from https://www.sumatrapdfreader.org and verifies pinned SHA-256 values.
It then invokes that executable as a separate process for printing.

Upstream license and source are available from the project and release tag:
https://github.com/sumatrapdfreader/sumatrapdf/blob/3.6.1rel/COPYING
https://github.com/sumatrapdfreader/sumatrapdf/tree/3.6.1rel

This download-only distribution model replaces the former bundled resource
workflow. If binaries are bundled in a future release, revisit the applicable
license and corresponding-source distribution requirements before publishing.
